description: Measured shape of one typical OpenCode Go task (a full autonomous root session). Consumed by lib/core/pipeline.js as PROFILES.agentic; replaces the former unsourced 7,750/147,250/300 guess.
instrument: local OpenCode message store (SQLite 'message' table), aggregate token counts only — no message content, no paths

window.selection: root sessions (session.parent_id IS NULL) of any model, rolling 6-week window

definition: One 'task' = one autonomous root session. Cache reuse and the context growth only emerge across a session, so the profile is expressed per session (turns x per-turn buckets), not per single turn.
notes: output is output + reasoning tokens: OpenCode stores them separately, but both bill at the output rate (verified against the per-message cost OpenCode itself computed).
'turns' is the median (p50) of root sessions; the mean (345) is inflated by a heavy tail (max ~4,820 turns).
sample is a single developer / machine / workflow — a heavy autonomous-agent profile, NOT representative interactive chat.

cacheWrite is small on the models measured here (deepseek/glm/kimi report 0); some adapters route fresh tokens to cache_write instead of input (observed on Qwen on OpenCode Go), which the tariff's cacheWritePerM then bills.
the store keeps per-message model ids, so mixing providers inside one session is handled by attributing each turn to its own model; this profile aggregates all models together.
prices OpenCode stored in the same rows match the published tariff rates for the models checked (deepseek, qwen), so the token volumes here are the transferable part — not a price fit.
reproduce: sqlite3 opencode.db "SELECT json_extract(data,'$.tokens.input'), json_extract(data,'$.tokens.cache.read'), json_extract(data,'$.tokens.cache.write'), json_extract(data,'$.tokens.output'), json_extract(data,'$.tokens.reasoning') FROM message WHERE json_extract(data,'$.role')='assistant' AND json_extract(data,'$.tokens.total')>0"
Group rows by session_id (message.session_id), keep sessions whose session.parent_id IS NULL within the last 6 weeks, then divide SUM(bucket) by SUM(turns) and take the median of turns/session.
